DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 時間ある？あるよね？？よしっ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: え、え？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: どうせ暇でしょ？だったら私と一緒にバイトして！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私のお手伝いをしてくれればいいから、OK？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあまたあとで！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: えっと……えぇ……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: セリカさん……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、また別のバイトが入ったから、前のところで待ち合わせね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 今回はちょっと特殊なバイトだよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 特殊な……？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 次のバイトが決まったよ！先生も来るよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 次の休日の午前中、公園に来てね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: りょうかーい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うう、腰が痛い……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生は大丈夫なの？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お風呂に浸かったらちょっとは良くなるかな思って、今

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 危なかった、スマホをお風呂に落とすとこだった……！！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: やっぱりお風呂に入る時にスマホは良くないかも……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 一旦外に置いてお風呂入るから、またあとでね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: その……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: セリカ、写真が……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 写真？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: うああああああ？！なんでこんなのが撮れてるの！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: み、見ないで！見るなぁ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まさか保存してないよね！？消して！！分かった！？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ちゃんと消したかどうかあとで確認するからね！！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 見てないです……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 消しました、はい

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: アヤネちゃんから聞いたんだけど、対策委員会に匿名の寄付が来たんだって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 金額はそんなに多くないけど、バイト一日分くらいはある金額らしくって

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 私たちのことを見てくれてる市民の人からなのかな、えへへ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、今度も例の場所で会おうね、先生！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: また午後に！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、今度は夜の市場でアルバイトだよ！

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 夜中までやるらしいから覚悟しておいてね！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 承知いたしました、セリカさん！

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 徹夜かもね、了解

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: お腹いっぱーい、ちょっと食べ過ぎたかも

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 小さい街だったけど、面白いものがたくさんあったね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まあ小さいって言っても、うちよりは大きかったけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 結局バイト代半分近く使っちゃったけど、たまにはこういうのも良いよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: じゃあまた明日、先生。お疲れ様

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: すぐ横にならないほうが良いかも、ゆっくり休んでね

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、お疲れ様。またね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生。今度の休日のバイト、覚悟しておいてね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: ものすごくハードな肉体労働みたいだから……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 武者震いが……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: OK、覚悟しておくね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 先生、今日アビドスに来るんだっけ？

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: うん、そうだよ

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 道中怪我したら危ないし、迎えに行こうと思うんだけど……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いいわよね？

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: あ、「大丈夫」は「来て大丈夫」って意味だと受け取るけど

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: 私に拒否権は無いんだね……

DialogJP.Speaker: Player
DialogJP.Text: でも嬉しいよ、ありがとう

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いや、本当に先生が事件に巻き込まれるかもしれないから言ってるの

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: 最近うちの自治区……ちょっとうるさい連中が来てて……

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: まぁそういうことだから、気をつけてね

DialogJP.Speaker: Student
DialogJP.Text: いざとなったら、私の後ろに隠れてて

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 어차피? 한가하잖아? 그럼 나랑 알바 같이 하자!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 내가 하는 거 보조만 하면 돼. 하는 거다?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님. 이번에도 알바가 들어왔어. 거기서 볼까?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 이번 알바가 정해졌어! 선생님도 올 거지?

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 하루종일 고개를 숙이고 있었더니 허리가 부러질 거 같아…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 욕조에 좀 담구고 있으면 괜찮을까 해서 지금

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 우, 우아아 폰을 욕조에 떨어트릴 뻔했어!!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 역시 목욕할 때 폰을 가지고 오면 안 돼…….

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아야네 쨩이 그러는데 요즘 대책위원회 앞으로 익명 기부가 들어온대.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 금액이 많은 건 아닌데 하루 알바 일당 정도의 돈이 가끔씩 들어오나 봐.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 역시 우리의 활약을 좋게 봐준 시민들의 기부금인가. 헤헤헤.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님. 이번엔 밤늦게까지 이어지는 야시장 보조야!

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 엄청 배불러. 오늘 장난 아니게 먹었어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 작은 마을인데도 재미있는 게 꽤 많더라.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 알바비 절반을 먹는데 써버렸지만……. 뭐, 가끔은 이런 것도 괜찮지 않겠어? 후후.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 선생님. 이번엔 모처럼의 휴일 알바, 각오해야 해.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 오늘 아비도스 자치구에 온다고 들었어. 선생님.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 그래서, 선생님의 안전을 위해 내가 마중 나갈 생각인데.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 괜찮지 않다고 해도 괜찮다는 뜻으로 받아들이겠어.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 아니, 이건 안전상의 문제이기도 해서 말이야.

DialogKR.Speaker: Student
DialogKR.Text: 최근 우리 자치구에…… 조금, 시끄러운 녀석들이 돌아다니고 있거든.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Senseeeiii!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Do you have time? You do, right?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Um... Huh?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You don't have a lot going on, right? So do some part-time work with me!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I just need someone to assist me. Is that cool with you?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Then I'll see you soon!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Huh? Excuse me?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Serika?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, I've got another part-time job. See you there?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This time it's something kind of special!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Huh? Something special...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Another part-time job confirmed! Are you coming, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll see you at the park on the next morning you have off!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Ugh. All right.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've been bending over all day. I feel like my back is about to break...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: How's your back, Sensei?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I thought soaking in the bathtub might help.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: So, ewiks.xc,z

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: AAAAAAA

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I almost dropped my phone in the tub!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Bringing my phone to the bath was probably a bad idea...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: See you later, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Oh. Um...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Serika. I, uh...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Huh?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ahhhhh! How did you get that photo?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: D-Don't look! Don't look!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll kill you! I'm going to check your phone later!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Delete it! All right?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm gonna check it later!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I didn't see anything.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I didn't see it. I deleted it. It's fine.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Ayane said the Foreclosure Task Force has been receiving anonymous donations lately.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's not a lot, but it's about the amount you'd expect from a day of part-time work.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Maybe it's from a citizen who recognizes our accomplishments. Heeheehee.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'll see you at the usual place, Sensei!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This afternoon, downtown!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This time, Sensei, it's an assistant position for the night market!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Make sure you're prepared!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: You got it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I'll expect to work all night.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'm so full. I ate so much today.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It was a small town, but it was full of fun stuff.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Well, I guess it was bigger than our town...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I spent half of my pay on food today... Well, I think it's okay to do that every once in a while. Heehee.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: See you tomorrow, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I hope you don't get a stomachache.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Sleep tight.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Sensei, I got us a part-time job on the weekend. Be prepared.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: It's gonna be hard labor...

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I can't stop shaking!

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: But I'm ready!

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I've heard you're going to visit Abydos, Sensei.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: That's the plan.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: I'd better meet you when you get here. For your safety.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You don't mind, right?

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: Even if you do mind, I'm doing it.

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: I've got no choice in the matter, huh?

DialogEN.Speaker: Player
DialogEN.Text: Well, I appreciate it. Thanks.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: This is really just a matter of your safety.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: We've had...troublemakers in our district lately...

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: You've got to be careful.

DialogEN.Speaker: Student
DialogEN.Text: If anything happens, just hide behind me.

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณณณครู!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: พอมีเวลาไหม???  มีใช่ไหม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อืม... เอ๊ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไหนๆ  ก็ไม่อะไรทำอยู่แล้ว ไปทำงาน
พิเศษกับฉันดีกว่า!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
แค่ไปช่วยฉันนิดหน่อยก็พอ เอาเป็นว่า
ตกลงนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งั้นเดี๋ยวเจอกัน!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ...หือ? ว่ายังไงนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เซริกะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ฉันมีงานเข้ามาล่ะ ไปเจอกันที่นั่น
ไหม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: งานครั้งนี้ค่อนข้างพิเศษเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: หืม? งานที่พิเศษเหรอ...?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ฉันเลือกงานพิเศษไว้แล้ว! คุณครูก็จะ
มาด้วยใช่ไหม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เจอกันตอนเช้าของวันหยุดที่สวนสาธา
รณะนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: กะ.. ก็ได้

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ก้มๆ เงยๆ ทั้งวันจนปวดเอวไปหมด...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครูไม่ปวดเอวเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อยากไปแช่ตัวในอ่างอาบน้ำให้หายปวด
จัง

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ไม่นะะะะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เฮ่อออ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เกือบทำโทรศัพท์ตกไปในอ่างอาบน้ำ
แล้ว!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ไม่ควรเอาโทรศัพท์มาเล่นตอนอาบน้ำ
จริงๆ ด้วย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: คุณครู ไว้เจอกันนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: เซริกะ... แบบว่า...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: หืม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อ๊าาาา?!
ทำไมรูปนั้นถึงถูกส่งไปได้ล่ะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ยะ...อย่ามองนะ! ห้ามดูนะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ถ้าเจอกันละก็.. โดนแน่!!!!!!!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ลบไปเลย!! เข้าใจไหม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วฉันจะไปเช็กดู!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ครูไม่เห็นอะไรเลย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ยังไม่ได้ดูเลย ครูลบไปแล้ว ลบแล้ว

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
อายาเนะจังบอกว่ามีคนนิรนามมาบริจาค
เงินให้คณะกรรมการแผนงานด้วย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
จำนวนเงินเท่าๆ กับค่าทำงานพิเศษวัน
หนึ่ง แต่บริจาคเข้ามาเรื่อยๆ เลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
นี่ต้องมาจากประชาชนที่เห็นผลงานการ
ทำงานของพวกเราแน่ ฮิฮิฮิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครั้งนี้ก็ไปเจอกันที่เดิมนะคุณครู!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ในเมืองตอนเย็น!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู ครั้งนี้เราต้องทำงานในตลาดโต้รุ่ง
และต้องทำยาวถึงดึกเลยด้วย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เตรียมตัวให้ดีล่ะ!

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: รับทราบขอรับบอส

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ต้องเตรียมตัวโต้รุ่งแล้วสิ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ท้องจะแตกแล้ว วันนี้ฉันกินไปเยอะมาก
เลยล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
นี่เป็นเมืองเล็กๆ แต่มีอะไรสนุกๆ อยู่
เพียบเลย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แต่ยังไงก็ใหญ่กว่าเมืองของเราอยู่ดี...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
เงินค่าจ้างวันนี้ครึ่งหนึ่งหมดไปกับของกิน
แล้ว... แต่นานๆ ทีได้สนุกแบบนี้ก็ไม่เป็น
ไรหรอกเนอะ? ฮุฮุ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แล้วเจอกันพรุ่งนี้นะคุณครู

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ระวังท้องเสียด้วยล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: กลับไปพักผ่อนด้วยนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู เตรียมตัวให้พร้อมสำหรับงานพิ
เศษวันหยุดนี้ด้วยล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ครั้งนี้เป็นงานใช้แรงงานซะด้วย...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ว่าไงนะ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: จะเตรียมตัวเป็นอย่างดีเลย!

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
คุณครู วันนี้จะมาที่เขตปกครอง
อะบิดอสเหรอ?

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: อื้อ ใช่แล้วละ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้างั้น... เดี๋ยวฉันออกไปรับคุณครูดีกว่า
จะได้แน่ใจว่าปลอดภัย

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: แบบนี้โอเคไหม?

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: เอาเป็นว่าโอเคก็แล้วกันนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: ถามเองตอบเองก็เป็นนะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Player
DialogTH.Text: แต่ยังไงก็ขอบคุณนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ก็นะ เพราะมันมีปัญหาเรื่องความ
ปลอดภัยด้วยแหละนะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ช่วงนี้... มันมีพวกที่ชอบก่อความวุ่นวาย
เข้ามาป้วนเปี้ยนในเขตของเราน่ะ...

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text: ยังไงก็เถอะ คราวนี้ก็ระวังตัวด้วยล่ะ

DialogTH.Speaker: Student
DialogTH.Text:
ถ้าเกิดอะไรขึ้นก็หลบอยู่ข้างหลังฉัน
ก็แล้วกัน

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 有時間嗎？有吧？？好！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 咦，咦？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 反正你也不忙吧？那就和我一起打工吧！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 只要幫忙我就行了，OK？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那麼待會兒見！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 那個……咦咦……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 茜香同學……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，又有一份新的打工，所以在上次的地方碰面哦！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 這次是稍微特殊的打工唷！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 特殊的……？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 下次的打工決定了唷！老師也會來吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 下個休息日的上午，來公園吧！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 了解～

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嗚嗚，腰痛……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師還好嗎？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我想泡個澡會好一點，現在

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 好險，手機差點掉進浴缸裡……！！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 洗澡的時候果然不能帶著手機……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我先把它放在外頭並洗個澡，回頭見唷

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 那個……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 茜香，照片……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 照片？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 哇啊啊啊啊啊啊！？為什麼會拍到這個！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 別，別看！不准看！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 沒有儲存對吧！？刪除！！明白了嗎！？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我之後會檢查有沒有刪掉哦！！！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 沒有看……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 是，刪除了

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 我聽綾音說，對策委員會收到了匿名捐款

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然金額不多，但好像有到打工一天的金額

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 是不是來自於關心我們的市民呢，嘿嘿

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊，這次也在老地方見吧，老師！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 下午見！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師，這次是在夜市打工唷！

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 也許會一路做到深夜，做好覺悟吧！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 知道了，茜香！

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 可能要通宵嗎，了解

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 肚子好飽啊，可能吃得有點多

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 雖然是個小街區，但有很多有趣的東西呢

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 嘛，雖然說它小，但還是比我們的大……

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 結果花了幾乎一半的打工薪水，但偶爾這樣也不錯吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 那就明天見囉，老師。辛苦了

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 最好不要馬上躺下，好好休息吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，辛苦了。回頭見

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 老師。這次休息日的打工，做好覺悟吧

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 好像是非常辛苦的體力勞動……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 渾身顫抖……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: OK，我會做好覺悟的

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 聽說你今天要來阿拜多斯自治區是嗎，老師

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 嗯，沒錯哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 為了保護老師的安全，我打算去接你

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 可以吧？

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 啊，如果你說「沒關係」我會當成「來也沒關係」的哦

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 我沒有拒絕的權利嗎……

DialogTW.Speaker: Player
DialogTW.Text: 不過你能這麼說我很高興。謝謝你

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 不，這也是安全上的問題

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 最近我們自治區……來了一些煩人的傢伙

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 總之這次還是小心為妙

DialogTW.Speaker: Student
DialogTW.Text: 覺得不對勁就躲到我身後吧
